paścāt yadā mahyam dīdharaḥ bhāgam indra: hasriṇam rayim pavantām ā suvīryam suvānāḥ devāsaḥ indavaḥ
ti śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigāti aṇvyā vagnum iyarti yam
iti tyam daśa kṣipaḥ mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ suāyudham
āśavaḥ abhi suvānāsaḥ indavaḥ vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīmiva
ime iti rodasī iti mahī iti sam mātarāiva dohate
avyaḥ vārebhiḥ arṣati sahvān viśvāḥ abhi spṛdhaḥ saḥ
nāsaḥ āśata hitāḥ na saptayaḥ rathe ā asmin piśaṅgam
gavyāni dhārayaḥ tatam tantum acikradaḥ somāḥ asṛgram
nṛbhiḥ yataḥ vi nīyase tvam soma nṛmādanaḥ pavasva
nim āsadam tam amṛkṣanta vājinam upasthe aditeḥ
te pavamānaḥ adhi dyavi pavitre matsaraḥ madaḥ eṣaḥ
ni te punānāya prabhūvaso iti prabhuvaso vardha samudram
suādhyaḥ pavamānāsaḥ akramuḥ rayim kṛṇvanti cetanam divaḥ
yathā hitam asme iti dhehi dyumat yaśaḥ maghavatbhyaḥ

vājī ni akramīt saḥ vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva

abhi viśvāni vāryā abhi devān ṛtavṛdhaḥ somaḥ
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ hariḥ oṃ pra ṇo yāsyaḥ sa pavasvāsṛgrann ayā somaḥ pañca

uru antarikṣam viśve devāḥ pavamānam juṣanta asāvi somaḥ

paścāt yadā mahyam dīdharaḥ bhāgam indra: yaḥ goḥ sahasram ṛkvā pathibhiḥ vacaḥvit adhvasmabhiḥ
camūṣu upa īm agman ṛṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ
naḥ vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāraḥ atbhiḥ maryaḥ na yoṣām abhi
yat kaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūraḥ na rathaḥ bhuvanāni viśvā
ti uśatīḥ uśantam tam marmṛjānam mahiṣam na sānau aṃśum duhanti
ye sarvatātaye bṛhate tat uśanti viśve ime sakhāyaḥ
raḥ śatavājaḥ induḥ vājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti saḥ
āyuḥ eṣaḥ syaḥ somaḥ matibhiḥ punānaḥ atyaḥ na vājī
dhanānām vṛṣāiva yūthā pari kośam arṣan kanikradat
tāiva sadma paśumanti hotā bhadrā vastrā samanyā vasānaḥ
rāhaḥ abhi eti rebhan pra haṃsāsaḥ tṛpalam manyum accha
ta dyām indrasyaiva vagnuḥ ā śṛṇve ājau pracetayan
pastyavān juṣṭaḥ madāya devatāte indo iti pari
nām dvitā bhuvat rayipatiḥ rayīṇām ṛtam bharat subhṛtam cāru
puraḥetā asi mahataḥ dhanasya divaḥ na sargāḥ asasṛgram
vaḥ dhenavaḥ vāvaśānāḥ somam viprāḥ matibhiḥ pṛcchamānāḥ

gobhiḥ asarat sam atbhiḥ eṣaḥ syaḥ te pavate indra
bhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ abhi yena draviṇam aśnavāma
ati yāti indum rihanti mahiṣāḥ adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayaḥ

vṛṣṭim na tanyatuḥ tvam vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi
oṃ purojitī ṣoḷaśa andhīguḥ śyāvāśvir yayātir nāhuṣo nahuṣo mānavo
